subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920 own reply-session conflict recovery canonically, with this PR reduced to a proven Discord fallback only if needed?
rationale: Both PRs address the same conflict at different ownership layers, and source review cannot determine whether maintainers want shared-only recovery or deliberate channel defense in depth.

options.title: Shared Canonical Recovery
options.body: Prefer the shared fenced self-heal, then re-evaluate whether any narrowly scoped Discord fallback remains necessary after live proof.

options.title: Land Both Layers
options.body: Keep the bounded Discord retry as explicit defense in depth after adding live conflict-to-redelivery proof and documenting the ownership split.

options.title: Channel-Only Recovery
options.body: Reject the shared self-heal direction and keep recovery policy in affected channel adapters, accepting duplicated cross-channel behavior.

recommendation.title: Shared Canonical Recovery
recommendation.body: Prefer the shared fenced self-heal, then re-evaluate whether any narrowly scoped Discord fallback remains necessary after live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history spans both the Discord handler and adjacent shared session-lifecycle decisions, making this the strongest available routing signal.
